regime_read: The pack shows a dense US-China semiconductor and AI-infrastructure convergence: MU, AMAT, NVDA, INTC, plus MSFT and PLTR carry overlapping congressional, patent, analyst and federal-flow signals, while healthcare names (MRK, ABBV) sit on clinical catalysts. No track record exists yet, so all conviction is held modest; nothing here is extreme enough to force an avoid on entry alone, though PLTR's 29pp RS is the closest to extended.
regime_read_zh: 今日证据包显示美中半导体与AI基础设施主题高度收敛：MU、AMAT、NVDA、INTC 以及 MSFT、PLTR 同时带有国会、专利、分析师与联邦资金流信号，医疗健康标的（MRK、ABBV）则叠加临床催化剂。当前尚无历史战绩，故所有确信度保持克制；单就入场而言没有标的极端到必须回避，但 PLTR 相对标普29个百分点的强度最接近过热。

theses.thesis: MU carries five independent channels: congressional cluster (net 6, 3 members) [congress_cluster], full 1.0 insider MSPR (no selling by tracked insiders) [insider_mspr], a large 400-patent cluster [patent_cluster], federal grant money with 0.32 acceleration [gov_grant_accel], and maximal Stocktwits bull ratio with over 213k watchers [stocktwits_bull]. Relative strength vs SPY is only 1.7, so the entry is not extended. Earnings sit 20 days out with a historically strong 18.6% surprise mark; the cluster is a bet on memory-cycle strength confirmed by insider and legislative alignment.
theses.thesis_zh: MU 汇聚五条独立渠道：国会群集（净+6、3名议员）[congress_cluster]、满分1.0的内部人MSPR（被追踪内部人无卖出）[insider_mspr]、多达400项的专利群 [patent_cluster]、联邦拨款加速0.32 [gov_grant_accel]，以及Bull比率1.0且超21.3万关注者的Stocktwits情绪 [stocktwits_bull]。相对标普强度仅1.7，入场并未过热。距财报20天且历史超预期18.6%；该群集押注的是由内部人与立法面共同确认的存储周期走强。
second_order: AMAT — memory capex read-through feeds semiconductor equipment demand
NVDA — HBM/content growth is a direct input-cost and demand complement
INTC — US memory/fab reshoring policy tailwind overlaps
theses.dissent: The 1.0 insider MSPR likely reflects no tracked insiders selling rather than fresh buying; Stocktwits 1.0 bull with a hot name is often late retail euphoria ahead of a memory-price top.

falsifier.text: MU guidance or spot DRAM/NAND pricing commentary at the Sept 30 print signals memory prices rolling over quarter-on-quarter

theses.thesis: AMAT is a laggard (RS -20.3) with four channels: analyst-upgrade cluster with 0.97 bull ratio [analyst_upgrade_cluster], congressional net +4 across 3 members [congress_cluster], a 256-patent cluster [patent_cluster], and unusual options activity with put/call 1.07 and OI/vol 0.611 [unusual_options]. The -20.3 RS means it has not priced the semiconductor-equipment recovery that MU's memory strength implies; this is the lower-multiple equipment exposure behind the memory thesis.
theses.thesis_zh: AMAT 是落后标的（相对标普 -20.3），具备四条渠道：分析师上调群集Bull比率0.97 [analyst_upgrade_cluster]、3名议员净+4的国会群集 [congress_cluster]、256项专利群 [patent_cluster]，以及看跌/看涨1.07、持仓量/成交量0.611的异常期权活动 [unusual_options]。-20.3的相对强度说明市场尚未反映MU存储走强对半导体设备的传导；这是存储主题背后估值更低的设备端暴露。
second_order: MU — stronger memory pricing drives AMAT tool orders
NVDA — advanced packaging/HBM equipment is a shared capex driver
INTC — fab buildouts compete for the same equipment suppliers
theses.dissent: Put/call of 1.07 is not clearly bullish positioning; the options signal could be hedging rather than accumulation, and a -20.3 RS laggard may be discounting structural share loss to ASML or Lam.

falsifier.text: AMAT's next earnings commentary or a major memory customer capex update shows tool orders being pushed out rather than pulled forward

theses.thesis: PLTR shows the highest convergence score in the pack (6) with six channels, but RS +29.4 is the warmest entry on the list, so this is a watch not an accumulate. Government contract acceleration is decisive: $26.4M awarded in 30 days at 1.76 acceleration [gov_contract], plus disclosed stakes from Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] and Cathie Wood affiliation [actor:Cathie Wood], retail buzz and a 1.0 Stocktwits bull ratio [retail_buzz][stocktwits_bull]. The trump-linked 'sell' tag [trump] is a headwind marker against the other flows.
theses.thesis_zh: PLTR 在本次证据包中收敛评分最高（6），具备六条渠道，但相对强度+29.4是列表中最热的入场点，因此只能观察而非累积。政府合同加速最为关键：30天内授予2637万美元、加速1.76 [gov_contract]，叠加众议员Marjorie Taylor Greene的公开持仓 [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene]、Cathie Wood的关联 [actor:Cathie Wood]、散户热度以及1.0的Stocktwits Bull比率 [retail_buzz][stocktwits_bull]。特朗普相关的“卖出”标签 [trump] 构成与其他资金流相反的压力信号。
second_order: MSFT — government AI/defense cloud budgets often flow to the same primes
NVDA — AI compute spend underpinning Palantir use cases
Defense-IT services names — PLTR wins pull along adjacent federal integrators
theses.dissent: RS +29.4 means much of the government-contract narrative is already priced; the trump 'sell' tag and a 1.0 retail bull ratio at high speed often mark late-stage enthusiasm.

falsifier.text: PLTR's next quarter shows government contract revenue decelerating or a major disclosed holder trimming while the stock is still extended

theses.thesis: NVDA sits at convergence 6 and RS +6 — not extended. Four disclosed politicians hold stakes including Pelosi [actor:Nancy Pelosi] and MTG [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene], and Jensen Huang controls the company [actor:Jensen Huang]. The analytical edge is modest: DPI 0.402 at z 0.64 [hf_model_momentum] is mildly positive, analyst bull ratio 1.0 [analyst_upgrade_cluster], retail buzz with 207 WSB mentions [retail_buzz], and a 218-patent cluster. This is a broad, well-known AI-infrastructure alignment rather than an unusual hidden edge, so conviction stays low.
theses.thesis_zh: NVDA 收敛评分6且相对强度+6，未过热。包括Pelosi [actor:Nancy Pelosi]、MTG [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene]在内的四名公开政客持有持仓，黄仁勋为实际控制人 [actor:Jensen Huang]。分析面优势温和：DPI 0.402（z值0.64）[hf_model_momentum] 略偏正，分析师Bull比率1.0 [analyst_upgrade_cluster]，WSB提及207 [retail_buzz]，218项专利群。这是广为人知的AI基础设施共振，而非罕见的隐性优势，故确信度保持低位。
second_order: MU — HBM is a core input and margin driver
AMAT — NVDA-led AI capex pulls equipment vendors
MSFT — hyperscaler GPU procurement is the demand anchor
theses.dissent: Multiple disclosed politician holdings are backward-looking and slow-moving; the modest DPI z-score of 0.64 is not a decisive smart-money signal, and retail buzz is high enough to be noise.

falsifier.text: A major AI-hyperscaler capex guidance cut or an export-control tightening that directly caps NVDA's China revenue trajectory

theses.thesis: MSFT carries five channels including the only outright trump 'buy' tag among the pack [trump], a massive app-demand footprint (4.77 rating, 20M+ reviews, 31.3M downloads in 30d) [app_demand], GitHub momentum at 191.5k stars [github_momentum], 431 patents [patent_cluster], and Aktman affiliation [actor:Bill Ackman]. The Sam Altman partnership [actor:Sam Altman] adds an OpenAI/AI-infrastructure read. RS +23 is elevated but below the +35 warning threshold; entry is intact but not cheap.
theses.thesis_zh: MSFT 具备五条渠道，包括全包中唯一明确的特朗普“买入”标签 [trump]、庞大的应用需求足迹（评分4.77、超2009万条评论、30天下载3133万）[app_demand]、GitHub动量19.15万星 [github_momentum]、431项专利 [patent_cluster]，以及Bill Ackman的关联 [actor:Bill Ackman]。Sam Altman的合作关系 [actor:Sam Altman] 叠加OpenAI/AI基础设施逻辑。相对强度+23偏高但未触及+35警示线；入场有效但价格不便宜。
second_order: NVDA — OpenAI/Microsoft GPU and infrastructure demand
AI data-centers/power themes — Azure capex is the anchor buyer
PLTR — enterprise AI adoption tailwind overlaps
theses.dissent: The 23.0 RS means much of the OpenAI/Azure narrative is already in the price; trump 'buy' tags are unreliable as a durable thesis and the AI moat is widely known.

falsifier.text: Azure growth decelerates at the next print or OpenAI shifts meaningful compute/infrastructure share away from Microsoft

theses.thesis: MRK is a healthcare tactical with four channels: 11 Phase 3 starts against 3 halts [clinical_phase3_start], FDA label expansion [fda_label_expansion], special-situation flag [special_situation], and a trump 'buy' tag [trump]. RS +21.8 is elevated for a large pharma, but the clinical catalyst mix is concretely positive and the name is not yet extended by the +35 test. Worth a modest overweight knowing the Senate healthcare bills (cancer care planning, nurse overtime, provider reimbursement) are compounding regulatory flux [bill_catalysts].
theses.thesis_zh: MRK 是具备四条渠道的医疗保健战术标的：11项III期启动对3项终止 [clinical_phase3_start]、FDA标签扩展 [fda_label_expansion]、特殊情境标记 [special_situation]，以及特朗普“买入”标签 [trump]。相对强度+21.8对大型药企而言偏高，但临床催化剂组合明确偏正，且尚未触及+35过热标准。参议院多项医疗法案（癌症照护规划、护士加班、报销稳定性）[bill_catalysts] 构成叠加的政策变量，可作适度超配。
second_order: ABBV — shared large-pharma clinical/FDA catalyst beta
Hospital/healthcare-services names — Medicare reimbursement bills create sector-level flow
Pharma-services CROs — phase 3 activity converts to trial services demand
theses.dissent: RS +21.8 in a large pharma with no earnings catalyst in the next 30 days could simply be defensive rotation; three clinical halts against eleven starts is not a decisive success ratio.

falsifier.text: A Phase 3 readout or FDA action on an MRK label expansion that fails or misses its primary endpoint while the stock sits near highs

theses.thesis: ABBV has only three channels and convergence 3, so this is a watch. Seven Phase 3 starts against two halts [clinical_phase3_start], FDA label expansion [fda_label_expansion], and two material 8-Ks in 30 days [material_8k]. RS +7.9 is quiet. The signal is real but thinner than MRK's; second-order to the healthcare legislative agenda rather than a standalone edge.
theses.thesis_zh: ABBV 仅有三条渠道且收敛评分3，因此只是观察。7项III期启动对2项终止 [clinical_phase3_start]、FDA标签扩展 [fda_label_expansion] 以及30天内两份重大8-K [material_8k]。相对强度+7.9平淡。信号真实但薄于MRK；属医疗立法议程的次生配置而非独立优势。
second_order: MRK — shared large-pharma catalyst beta
Immunology/dermatology biologics — ABBV's label expansions feed that niche
Pharma-services CROs — additional clinical activity
theses.dissent: Two material 8-Ks in 30 days could just as easily be negative operational disclosures as positive catalysts; the clinical ratio alone is too thin for a standalone overweight.

falsifier.text: ABBV's next material 8-K or FDA correspondence reveals a label-expansion setback or a Phase 3 futility stop

theses.thesis: HUT is not in the main cluster list but is surfaced by the label-mismatch layer with 0.85 confidence: the entity branded 'American Bitcoin' (ABTC) is actually ~80% owned by Hut 8, which has pivoted to AI power/data-center infrastructure with a $7B Anthropic/Fluidstack 245MW deal, a $9.8B Beacon Point lease, and a >$16.8B pipeline [label_mismatches, entity:American Bitcoin]. This is a repointed identity: the crypto-branded wrapper now has an AI-infrastructure real theme. No direct cluster channels, so conviction stays low and this is a watch.
theses.thesis_zh: HUT 不在主群集列表，但由标签错配层以0.85置信度浮出：被品牌包装为“American Bitcoin”（ABTC）的实体实为Hut 8持有约80%股权的公司，后者已转向AI电力与数据中心基础设施，涉及Anthropic/Fluidstack的2.45亿瓦、70亿美元交易、98亿美元Beacon Point租约及超168亿美元管线 [label_mismatches, entity:American Bitcoin]。这是一个身份重定：加密货币外壳下的真实主题是AI基础设施。因缺乏直接群集渠道，确信度保持低位，仅作观察。
second_order: AI data-center power/logistics names — Hut 8's pivot is a demand signal for that niche
MSFT/NVDA — anchor AI-infrastructure spend
HUT's power suppliers/partners — the pipeline monetization pull-through
theses.dissent: This is a single-signal, qualitative repoint with no independent cluster confirmation in today's pack; the crypto-branded wrapper can still carry volatility unrelated to the AI-infrastructure pivot.

falsifier.text: Hut 8 fails to execute the Anthropic/Fluidstack or Beacon Point milestones, or the >$16.8B pipeline fails to convert into signed revenue

theses.thesis: IEP is another label-mismatch repoint at 0.88 confidence: the entity 'CVR Energy' (CVI) is branded as energy-transition but is actually the energy segment inside Carl Icahn's activist-value holding company [label_mismatches, entity:CVR Energy]. The real theme is activist value investing, parent IEP. No direct cluster channels today, so this is a watch on structural value rather than a convergence edge.
theses.thesis_zh: IEP 是另一项标签错配重整（置信度0.88）：被包装为能源转型标的的“CVR Energy”（CVI）实为Carl Icahn积极的维权型控股公司内部的能源板块 [label_mismatches, entity:CVR Energy]。真实主题是维权价值投资，母体为IEP。今日无直接群集渠道，因此这是对结构性价值的观察而非收敛型优势。
second_order: CVI — IEP's energy segment directly benefits from parent-level value surface
Automotive/real-estate value names — IEP's diversified activist holdings
Broad energy-refining complex — CVR exposure overlaps
theses.dissent: A label repoint is not an informational edge about cash flows or catalysts; IEP is a diversified holding company with no cluster signal today, so it could simply track broad market value.

falsifier.text: IEP's consolidated NAV or Icahn's disclosed positioning shows the energy/auto/real-estate segments deteriorating on a sum-of-parts basis without a catalyst
